profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer, Gameplay at Blizzard Entertainment

positions.title: Senior Gameplay Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on gameplay features for Diablo 4

positions.title: Senior AI/Gameplay Software Engineer
positions.description:
Unannounced UE4 Action Game
- I created systems in C++ using Unreal Engine for controlling and authoring complex, fast-paced AI entities and associated gameplay features and editor tools/visualizers including multiplayer support.

NBA 2K13-2K19
- I worked on a large variety of animation-based gameplay features and gameplay systems such as animation selection, input, physics, game-balance, tools, and more.

NBA 2K Online (released in China, 2012)
- Implemented a new mouse-based PC control scheme, drills, tutorials, and other gameplay features.

positions.title: Software DV Engineer in Graphics
positions.description:
Model such graphics hardware features as color blending, anti-aliasing, and compute shader in C++.
Maintain C++ abstraction layer and write tests that work on both verilog and software models of chip.
Maintain a very large perl script dedicated to checking the correctness of each transaction in my block.

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description: Added additional hardware to Sun's OpenSPARCT1 to research the possibility of a runtime validation solution to the memory consistency problem in a multi-core environment

positions.title: Intern in Digital Verification
positions.description: Performance and Functional testing of a software/hardware mpeg4 encoder/decoder solution.
